# İstima

> İstima is a free, open-source Chrome extension that reads Turkish news articles aloud. Speech is generated on the user's device by the Antalia-2 Mini or EMA Lightning text-to-speech models (Apache-2.0) running in ONNX Runtime Web; no text or audio leaves the computer.

- [Ana sayfa (Turkish)](https://istima.ubeydgencer.com/): features, how it works, FAQ, install
- [Gizlilik politikası](https://istima.ubeydgencer.com/gizlilik/): privacy policy (no data collected)
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/idnhjopkmlgdhipcfplknfdfpkcehhle)
- [Source code](https://github.com/ubeydgencer/istima)
